findings.rationale: 'the six such entries in Table 1 are instances of the compiler-trust axiom Lean.ofReduceBool': axioms.out prints the witness axioms as per-declaration '..._native.native_decide.ax_N' and never the name Lean.ofReduceBool; the only receipt naming Lean.ofReduceBool is the H7 receipt's caveat (i) for the H7 _check theorems. The identification is a statement about Lean's native_decide implementation, not a receipt line. It is the fix the v4 audit suggested and the sentence correctly says the H7 lists were not printed.
findings.suggested_fix: 'are the per-declaration form of the compiler trust that the H7 receipt names as Lean.ofReduceBool'.
